Let \(x=c^2-3c+17\). Since \(0<x<90^\circ\), \(\sin x^\circ\) is one-to-one, so
\[
x=\arcsin\left(\frac{4}{b-2}\right),
\]
with \(b>6\). Then
\[
c^2-3c+17=x
\]
gives
\[
c=\frac{3\pm\sqrt{4x-59}}{2}.
\]
Thus \(c\) depends on the unspecified value of \(b\), so no unique value can be determined.

\[
\boxed{\text{not uniquely determined}}
\]
